_doc: gpt-oss-20b row of the throughput grid. Same protocol as qwen3_8b.json;
the gpt-oss-specific pins below are what produced the published numbers:
- moe-runner-backend triton_kernel: native MXFP4 experts (~14.9 GB weights
vs 39.5 GB dequantized-bf16), freeing ~25 GB for KV.
- prefill_backend triton: fa3 prefill asserts on gpt-oss's SWA layers with
- SGLANG_SWA_POOL_TOKENS=1048576 on quant arms: the default swa ratio sizes
the (uncompressed) sliding-window tier off the full tier's TOKEN count,
which self-defeats exactly when the full tier is compressed. bf16 keeps
the default -- measured at its ceiling either way.
radix + mixed pool trips an idle accounting check; demoted to a warning,
the cell gates (no_retract/full_length/server_agrees) police real fallout.
- SGL_VQ2_CONFIG_JSON: decode stage-1 launch table tuned at this geometry

- Quant arms inherit the keep-prefix-tail evictor (serve-script default ON): cached prefixes retain ~(window+ring) SWA tokens instead of full length, which is what lets bs=max reach the full-tier bound. The originally published grid ran the stock evictor and reached the same operating region via tree eviction; measured equivalent within noise.
